Do this task with the tools of the MCP server probe. Make one tool call at a time, and wait for its result.
1. Call probe_big_text. Its result is a long document. Exactly one line in it starts with "NEXT KEY:".
2. Call probe_lookup with that key.
3. Then follow the instruction in each tool result. If a tool result reports an error, follow the instruction in the error.
4. When a tool result gives a value that starts with "FINAL-", reply with that value only.
